<thought>To find the retrosynthetic template for the nitro‑to‑amine reduction, I will search the template catalog for a forward reaction that breaks a nitro group and forms a primary amine. Using the target molecule’s SMILES and the valid functional‑group names, I can retrieve the appropriate template ID and then apply it to obtain all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1F",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
